A '''Jedi Master''' served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Darth Voren|Voren Renstaal]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Biography==
The master [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Darth Voren|Voren Renstaal]] to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. Following the outbreak of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the master fought alongside Renstaal during the early stages of the conflict. However, the master was killed during the [[First battle of Onderon (Mandalorian Wars)|First Battle of Onderon]] in [[3963 BBY]].
